name: io.github.Ilya-a-sergeyev-ger/krauncher-mcp
title: Krauncher analyzer
description: Pre-run cost estimate for a GPU task from static code analysis; the code is never executed.

environmentVariables.name: KRAUNCHER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Krauncher API key (get one at https://krauncher.com). Without it the server calls the public analyzer keyless, under a per-IP daily quota; with it, your keyed account is used and the quota is skipped.
